[[:db/add 0 :db/ident :person/name] [:db/add 0 :db/valueType :db.type/string] [:db/add 0 :db/cardinality :db.cardinality/one]]
[[:db/add 0 :db/ident :person/age] [:db/add 0 :db/valueType :db.type/long] [:db/add 0 :db/cardinality :db.cardinality/one]]
[[:db/add 0 :db/ident :fin/price] [:db/add 0 :db/valueType :db.type/double] [:db/add 0 :db/cardinality :db.cardinality/one]]
[[:db/add 0 :db/ident :person/employer] [:db/add 0 :db/valueType :db.type/ref] [:db/add 0 :db/cardinality :db.cardinality/one]]
[[:db/add -1 :person/name "Alice"] [:db/add -1 :person/age 30] [:db/add -1 :fin/price 1234.5678]]
[[:db/add -2 :person/name "Bob"] [:db/add -2 :fin/price 0.1] [:db/add -2 :person/age 25]]
[:find ?n ?a :where [?e :person/name ?n] [?e :person/age ?a]]
[:find ?n ?p :where [?e :person/name ?n] [?e :fin/price ?p]]
[:find ?p :where [?e :fin/price ?p]]
[:find ?n :where [?e :person/name ?n] [(> ?a 20)] [?e :person/age ?a]]
[:find ?n :where [?e :person/name ?n] [(> ?unbound 1)]]
[:find ?n :where [?e :person/name ?n]]
[:find ?n :where [?e :person/name ?n]];
-- a comment line
.kv-put 10 greeting hello
.kv-get 10 greeting
.kv-scan 10
.kv-delete 10 greeting
.kv-get 10 greeting
.kv-put 10 onlykey
.kv-get 5 key
.dump BADINDEX
.dump 5
.badcommand
.help
.dump 10
